source_note: 只画照片中一尊罗汉及紧邻山石塑壁，不画今古物馆。依据实拍保留不完整手部、衣缘和少量颜面缺损，色层斑驳以稀疏断线概括；不补成完整手印。另下载的第二尊及紫金庵照片均未传入本次生成。图版所取2004年照片为历代修补后的现状，不作宋代彩绘复原。输入输出已目视核查。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: ONE actual surviving SEATED CLAY ARHAT of BAOSHENG TEMPLE, LUZHI, SUZHOU 苏州甪直保圣寺罗汉塑像（单尊局部）. Image2 is Gisling's real frontal photograph of the selected figure, and is the ONLY geometry reference. Depict this EXACT solitary seated arhat and the narrow rock-and-cloud niche immediately enclosing him, not the modern protection hall and not an invented complete eighteen-arhat wall. Preserve his slightly stooped upright torso, BALD monk head, short cranial form, elongated weathered face with the actual uneven surviving nose/mouth/cheek surface, long ear shapes, wide robe collar crossing diagonally over the chest, layered robe hem, two bent knees spreading to either side, and the irregular exposed toe/robe fragment at the bottom. Keep the head and body proportions of the real slender arhat, not the large rounded Vairocana in the style master. CRITICAL: the hands/forearms in the reference are NOT complete visible hands; preserve the robe-sleeve ends and surviving irregular stumps as photographed. Do NOT invent a meditation mudra, joined hands, new fingers or a bowl. Render4to8selective broken-edge contours at the genuine face, shoulder and robe losses rather than restoring the figure into a new smooth idol. Preserve the actual narrow flanking vertical abstract mountain forms with two large rounded projections beside the upper body and a little twisting cloud-rock behind the head, using only a FEW natural broken contours. Keep the modest rectangular base underneath the statue as photographed. Rock and figure entirely WHITE inside very thin BLACK outlines. Omit peeling pigment texture, mottled stains, lichen, flash shine, dense stone grain and all dark cavern shadows; do not reproduce every crack. Use only the main3to5curved folds over each knee and selected collar lines. Delicate sparse organic drawing strongly matching image1, not dense engraving or phototrace. Portrait1024x1536, entire selected statue and immediate niche centered at about80%height, all head, knees and base uncut with ample white margin. No textual labels, no ornaments invented, no new halo.

historical_sources.title: The statues of Arhats in the Baosheng Temple
historical_sources.evidence: 现保存九尊罗汉，错落置于山、云、石、树、洞窟与海水构成的塑壁内；塑壁宽9.50米、高5.70米。古物馆为保护陈列建筑，与塑像年代分开。

site_recommendation.name: 保圣寺
site_recommendation.sub: 罗汉塑像 · 山水塑壁
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1050仅作北宋年代的时间轴约略定位，非确切塑造年；原始1961国保名单列北宋，传为唐杨惠之作不作作者定论。
site_recommendation.lede: 罗汉坐在起伏的山石与云气之间，清瘦面容和宽袍衣纹仍有神采。保圣寺保存的半堂塑壁，把人物与山水一同塑进了墙面。

facts.label: 北宋塑像
facts.text: 1961年首批国保名单将保圣寺罗汉塑像定为北宋；唐代杨惠之创作的说法属传统归属。

facts.label: 半堂九尊
facts.text: 现存九尊罗汉坐像错落分布于塑壁，姿势和神情各异，本图选择其中一尊。

facts.label: 山水入壁
facts.text: 山石、云气、洞窟等构成塑壁背景，人物嵌在山水之间；今日保护馆的建造年代另计。
